blocks.text: Any accumulation of water in an excavation or basement shall be removed by means other than draining to the sanitary sewer before the blind plug is removed. (Ord. 19496 § 57, 12-21-10; Ord. 16388 § 7.14, 11-5-91. Code 1995 § 146-285. Formerly 14.80.450.)
